verifications.claim: The 2021 edition of the World Baseball Classic was postponed to 2023.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'The 2023 WBC, which was postponed from 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic'; R3: 'the edition due to be held in 2021 was cancelled and replaced with the one this year in 2023'; R6: 'The 2021 event was delayed to 2023 as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the postponement from 2021 to 2023 due to COVID-19.

verifications.claim: The next World Baseball Classic tournament is scheduled for March 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'scheduled for March 2026'; R2: 'The 2026 WBC was played March 3–17'; R4: 'The World Baseball Classic will return in 2026'; R6: '2026 World Baseball Classic... held during the month of March'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently confirm the 2026 tournament was scheduled for and held in March, aligning with the claim regardless of tense.

verifications.claim: World Baseball Classic tournaments were held in 2006, 2009, 2013, 2017, and 2023.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: All listed years are explicitly confirmed as held in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: The World Baseball Classic has experienced cycles of three to six years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'held at irregular intervals... 2006... three years later in 2009... four-year cycle... 2017... 2021... replaced... 2023... next... 2026'; R6: 'three-year gap between the first two... every four years following the 2009... 2021 delayed to 2023... 2026... triennial'

verifications.claim: The World Baseball Classic is currently structured for every four years.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'after... 2009, the interval... expanded to every four years' (past); R6: 'triennial (i.e., occurring once every three years)'; R4: 'return in 2026' (3 years from 2023); R3: 'next... 2026' (3 years from 2023)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe past four-year structure but current/next as three years or triennial, contradicting 'every four years' now.

verifications.claim: The World Baseball Classic was originally planned for a four-year cycle.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'After the second tournament, held in 2009, the interval between events was expanded to every four years'; R3: 'then switched to a four-year cycle'; R6: 'After a three-year gap between the first two installments... plans were made for... every four years following the 2009 event'
verifications.reasoning: Four-year cycle planned after 2009 (following initial 3-year gap), not originally.

verifications.claim: The World Baseball Classic takes place in March.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'March 2026'; R2: 'It is held in March'; R4: 'held in March'; R6: 'held during the month of March'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly state it occurs in March.

verifications.claim: The World Baseball Classic coincides with MLB spring training
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'held in March, during Major League Baseball (MLB) spring training'; R4: 'Major League players report back to their respective Spring Trainings following the conclusion'; R6: 'coinciding with the spring training pre-season... Major League Baseball (MLB)'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly link WBC timing to MLB spring training.
